[[File:Mooleta detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''mooleta''' is a melee off-hand dropped by the post-quest version of [[Brutus]]. It has no requirements to wield and offers similar bonuses to a [[steel defender]].

The mooleta is the only [[Shield slot table|shield slot]] item in [[free-to-play]] to give a melee [[strength]] bonus, as well as [[stab]], [[slash]], and [[crush]] attack bonuses.

==Trivia==
* The item's name is a play on both "moo" and {{WP|muleta}}, a stick with a red cloth hanging from it used by a bullfighter to manoeuvre the bull.
* The Mooleta was initially proposed as a members' only item, but was later changed to a free-to-play item some time during development.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/winter-summit-2026---overview?oldschool=1|title=Winter Summit 2026 - Overview|newsdate=25 January 2026|quote=Please note that all of the rewards being offered outside of the Cow Bell Amulet, Rump Steak and Bull Bones are '''members-only'''. We welcome feedback on what rewards you think are appropriate to be accessible in F2P, and we'd welcome exploring that further in a separate poll.}}
